General.Description:
Dr. Caleb James has spent twenty years chasing supercell thunderstorms across the American Great Plains. He has launched sensor arrays into F4 tornadoes, survived a direct strike that destroyed his vehicle, and lost two colleagues to the storms he loves. He has also developed a model that he believes can predict where and when a tornado will touch down with ninety percent accuracy — a breakthrough that could save thousands of lives.

To prove it, he needs to get a device called TEMPEST into the heart of a Category Five storm system. He needs a team willing to drive directly toward a wall of spinning destruction that no sane person would approach. And he needs it done before a rival meteorologist publishes flawed research that could set the field back by a decade.

Storm Chasers is an exhilarating adventure built around real atmospheric science. Petra Montague spent a full season embedded with a professional storm-chasing team in Oklahoma to research this novel, and it shows in every supercharged scene. The science is sound, the danger is real, and the human dynamics within the team — rivalry, romance, grief, courage — give the story an emotional core that outlasts the adrenaline.

A thunderclap of a book.
